className.description: Additional class name to add to the search input.

disabled.description: When true the search input will be disabled.

fluid.description:
When true the results will take up the width of its container.  This applied to the results container and not the
search input itself.

minCharacters.description: Minimum characters to query for results

placeholder.description: The placeholder text to show when the User has not yet typed any thing.

showNoResults.description:
Whether a "no results" message should be shown if no results are found.  When false noResultsDescription and
noResultsMessage will be ignored.

size.description: Size to render the search results.

planner.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.Planner} that should be used to generate and execute the plan.

title: Configuration options for a {@link https://react.semantic-ui#com/modules/search/ Semantic UI React} component.
name: GenAiUiSemanticSearchConfig
